GeoGebraPlayerUrl.description: Absolute URL of the sandboxed GeoGebra player page served from a cookie-less origin (e.g. https://ggb.ronzz.org/player.html). Empty = embedding disabled; [[File:x.ggb]] then renders a plain link to the file.

GeoGebraDefaultApp.description: GeoGebra app name used when an embed does not request one (classic/graphing/geometry/3d/suite/evaluator/scientific/notes).

GeoGebraDefaultWidth.description: Default applet width in pixels when the embed does not specify one.

GeoGebraDefaultHeight.description: Default applet height in pixels (also the aspect ratio used when only a width is given).

GeoGebraIframeSandbox.description: sandbox attribute for the player iframe. allow-same-origin is safe here because the player origin differs from the wiki origin — the applet cannot reach the wiki DOM, cookies or session.
